# DiskCleaner
> A macOS utility app that removes junk files, system logs, and clutter to free up disk space. Free trial includes 3 scans. $9.99 one-time purchase after — no subscription.

> Full reference: https://www.diskcleaner.pro/llms-full.txt

## About
- Name: DiskCleaner
- Platform: macOS 13 Ventura through macOS 26 Tahoe
- Category: Utilities / Disk Cleaner / Mac Storage Optimizer
- Price: Free trial (3 scans included); $9.99 one-time after (no subscription, covers up to 2 Macs)
- Privacy: 100% local — no network calls, no data collection, no account required
- Architecture: Universal Binary — native Apple Silicon and Intel support
- Website: https://www.diskcleaner.pro
- Support: customersupport@diskcleaner.pro

## What It Does
DiskCleaner scans junk on macOS and shows you every file before moving anything. Quick Scan covers seven categories; Deep Scan adds larger storage areas.

### Quick Scan categories
1. App Cache — cached data from installed applications
2. Browser Cache — supports 9 browsers: Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave, Opera, Arc, Vivaldi, Tor (all profiles)
3. Screenshots — old screenshots accumulated on your Desktop
4. Trash Contents — files already sitting in your Trash
5. System Logs — diagnostic logs and crash reports generated by macOS
6. Developer Data — Xcode derived data, iOS Simulators, CocoaPods, npm caches, build artifacts
7. App Leftovers — residual preference files and support data from uninstalled apps

### Deep Scan adds
- Large Files — surfaces oversized files across the disk for review
- Downloads folder — forgotten installers, archives, and exported files
- iOS Backups — old device backups that can consume tens of gigabytes
- Mail Attachments — attachment caches from Mail, Outlook, Spark, and Canary
- External drive review — clutter visibility beyond the startup disk

## Key Features
- Zero-decision cleanup: every file is shown in a checklist before anything moves
- Trash-first safety: all cleaned files go to macOS Trash — nothing is permanently deleted
- Private and local: no internet connection required, no accounts, no telemetry
- Menu Bar App: quick disk usage overview accessible from your Mac's menu bar
- RAM Optimizer: live Memory Pressure, Compressed Memory, Swap Used, and Page In/Out metrics with one-tap memory optimization
- App Uninstaller: cleanly remove apps and all their associated leftover files, with drag-and-drop support
- Large Files scanner: find and review oversized files taking up space across your disk
- Per-file checkboxes: granular control — approve or skip individual files
- Universal Binary: full native performance on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs

## Safety Philosophy
DiskCleaner never permanently deletes files. Every item moved goes to macOS Trash, where it can be reviewed and recovered. Users see a complete checklist of every file before anything is moved. Personal files, documents, photos, and passwords are never scanned or touched.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is DiskCleaner safe?
A: Yes. No file is ever permanently deleted. Everything goes to macOS Trash and is recoverable. You review every file before anything moves.

Q: Does DiskCleaner collect my data or connect to the internet?
A: Never. It runs 100% locally. No network calls, no data collection, no account required. Your file names and disk contents never leave your machine.

Q: What macOS versions are supported?
A: macOS 13 Ventura through macOS 26 Tahoe. Universal Binary for Apple Silicon and Intel.

Q: Is there a free trial?
A: Yes. DiskCleaner includes 3 free scans with no account required. After the trial, a one-time $9.99 purchase unlocks the app for up to 2 Macs and includes all future updates — no subscription ever.

Q: Is there a subscription?
A: No. $9.99 one-time purchase covers up to 2 Macs and includes all future updates.

Q: How is it different from other Mac cleaners?
A: Most cleaners delete files silently. DiskCleaner shows you every single file first, with per-file checkboxes, and only moves files to Trash — never permanent deletion.
